summary: @or-sdk/library preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: On `npm install`, the package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13) for the installer's platform, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it with the sibling file `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`). `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a ~1000-entry string-array shuffle (`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`) and hex-mangled identifiers; it is unrelated to the advertised HTTP SDK code that lives in `dist/cjs/` and is not mentioned in the README. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXXXX` identifiers and per-function lookup-object trampolines) despite implementing only a download-unzip-exec launcher. The README markets `@or-sdk/library` as a `LibraryV1`/`LibraryV2` HTTP SDK and does not disclose the Bun runtime download, the sibling payload, or install-time code execution. The net effect on `npm install` is that an alien runtime is downloaded to the installer's machine and used to execute a deliberately unreadable bundled payload of unknown behavior, bypassing Node.js-focused scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
